description: iOS Portal 2 client: the Portal iOS profile's static composition, pins, SDL3 app shell and native Vulkan renderer over MoltenVK, with the portal2 game target. Built on Linux by build-ios-portal2-app.sh (build-ios-app.sh with this profile); signed and installed on a Mac.

intent.support_scope: iOS build slice for the separate Portal 2 target (user direction, 2026-09-26: 'build play_p2 but for iOS'). Not platform acceptance: nothing of the Portal iOS profile's device evidence carries over.
intent.packaging: .app assembled on Linux, signed and installed on the Mac by ios-deploy.sh --profile with this profile. Licensed retail Portal 2 content (VPKs, loose maps and materials, about 12 GB) is staged from a Steam installation by tools/quality/stage_portal2_runtime.py and copied into the app's Documents separately.
intent.physics_provider: vphysics_box3d (Box3D), as in ./play_p2 and the Portal iOS profile (launcher_main/ios_main.cpp)
intent.video_provider: none: the Bink provider needs FFmpeg, which no Apple profile pins; the menu uses the staged background image

ios.bundle_id_reason: A separate app beside Portal (com.panos.sourceengine), so both stay installed with their own Documents. Agent decision, 2026-09-26.

static_composition.note: Portal 2's game modules declare the script manager as a shared app system in static products; the composition root links vscript and binds it (launcher_main/static_composition.cpp).

content.staging: tools/quality/stage_portal2_runtime.py --mount-custom: the retail search-path order spelled out in portal2/gameinfo.txt, plus <game>/custom/* for the app's touch icons

known_blockers: Retail Portal 2 content is about 12 GB on the device
